Do I Need Toilet Repair Services?

If you have a clog that won’t shift, no matter how long you plunge, or a toilet that frequently backs up into your home, it’s time to call in a licensed plumber. The Rosenberg Plumbing & Air team can quickly figure out the problem that’s causing your recurring issues and recommend a cost-effective solution.

Our diagnostics are comprehensive and use the latest technology to find even the smallest, most invisible issues. We solve all your bathroom problems, from rocking toilets to constantly running water.

If you hear the water in your tank running for extended periods of time, you probably also see an increase in your water bill. A leaky toilet tank can cost hundreds of dollars, while a silent leak can be even more expensive. The Rosenberg Plumbing & Air team is fully equipped to handle any type of plumbing fault, so you can count on USS when you need toilet repairs.

blocks.text: While we can repair most parts of your toilet, there are some failures that mean it’s time for a toilet replacement. We also recommend putting in higher toilets to support aging family members if you have loved ones with mobility challenges. No matter why you need a toilet replacement, you can trust Rosenberg Plumbing & Air to do the job right.
